outcome_detail: $6-million suit filed in Ontario Superior Court in November 2022; as of February 2025 the London Police Service declined comment citing ongoing litigation. No settlement, judgment or dismissal reported as of July 2026.
criminal_detail: Ontario's Special Investigations Unit charged retired officer Edward (Ted) Lane in February 2025 with two counts of historical sexual assault (alleged incidents in London between 1985-1987 and 1988-1991), with a first court appearance scheduled March 12, 2025; no disposition reported as of July 2026. The two other accused officers, Brian Garraway and Keith Bull, are deceased and were never charged.
incident_date_approx: Alleged abuse beginning around 1967 when the plaintiff was 12 (two officers, roughly 18 months) and roughly 1985-1991 when she was in her 30s (third officer); first reported to authorities in early 1994
description: A woman from Oneida Nation of the Thames filed a $6-million lawsuit in Ontario Superior Court in November 2022 against the London Police Service and three of its officers: the estates of Brian Garraway and Keith Bull, who are deceased, and retired officer Edward (Ted) Lane. The suit alleges two officers sexually assaulted her over about 18 months starting when she was 12, that Lane's abuse began when she was about 30 and continued for five years, and that the service failed to act on her reports, which she says began in early 1994 with a call to the then police chief. According to reporting, a paternity test confirmed Lane fathered her two daughters. In February 2025, Ontario's Special Investigations Unit charged Lane with two counts of historical sexual assault covering 1985-1987 and 1988-1991. The police service has declined to comment, citing ongoing litigation.
notes: Companion record rec-82b covers a separate $4-million lawsuit brought on behalf of the plaintiff's two daughters.
